purpose: Teach: プロダクション/自負/特長/館長/主語/一部分/コンセンサス/求む

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、独立プロダクションを支援された
lines.en: When you were founding the company, you supported independent production companies.
lines.style: Gentle, measured reflection. Patient breath. Speaking from memory rather than recitation. The voice of someone honoring what he has witnessed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営の質に自負を持ってらした
lines.en: Yes. You had real pride in the quality of your management.
lines.style: Affirming, steady. A son acknowledging his father's conviction without embellishment. Respectful but not deferential. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品の特長を消費者目線でお決めだった
lines.en: You made product decisions with the customer's eye in mind.
lines.style: Soft, contemplative. The voice of someone seeing his father's choices clearly now, perhaps more clearly than before. Slight weight of admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社史館長を任命された
lines.en: Yes. You appointed the company museum director.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. A simple statement of fact delivered with quiet respect. No apology, no over-explanation. The directness of someone who understands what this meant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、文章の主語を明確にされた
lines.en: You insisted on clarity in writing — clear subjects in every sentence.
lines.style: Wistful but grounded. The voice of someone recognizing a principle his father lived by. Not quite a smile, but warmth in the precision. Slight pause after 'sentence' like it lands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業の一部分を譲渡される決断もされた
lines.en: Yes. You made the decision to divest part of the business.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful. Recognition of a difficult choice made deliberately. No weight of regret — just honest acknowledgment of what he chose and why. The voice of understanding its cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、役員のコンセンサスを丁寧に取られた
lines.en: You took the time to build real consensus with the executives.
lines.style: Soft admiration. The voice of someone who sees the careful work behind that consensus. Not fast, not easy — but done with intention. Trailing slightly, like it matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは「人材求む」の信念を貫かれた
lines.en: Yes. You lived by the principle that we needed the right people.
lines.style: Grounded finality. A son speaking his father's belief back to him with clarity and conviction. Not a question, not hesitation — a statement that closes something important. Warm, but firm.
